name: Anine Bing
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $210 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's blazers around $650, sweatshirts around $200, T-shirts, leather pants, boots, bags and caps, sold through its own stores, site and Nordstrom.
origin: Founded in Los Angeles, United States in 2012 by Anine Bing; Nicolai Bing.

ownership.owner: ANINE BING (founder-led; venture-backed by Index Ventures, Greycroft and Felix Capital, 2018)

quote.q: Blending elements of Scandinavian simplicity with American energy, ANINE BING offers modern wardrobe essentials for women seeking a timeless yet confident approach to everyday style.

opview: “Blending elements of Scandinavian simplicity with American energy, ANINE BING offers modern wardrobe essentials for women seeking a timeless yet confident approach to everyday style.” — ANINE BING (house), Our Story, aninebing.com

facts_read.source: brand site; Index Ventures release 2018; nordstrom.com search; Vinted catalogue; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory; GOTS database

price_read.sublines: ANINE BING women's ready-to-wear and shoes (incl. Sport); lingerie, bags, jewelry, fragrance, food/drink excluded

doors.note: site aninebing.com (/pages/stores redirects to /blogs/locations); 34 stores worldwide (17 US, 3 Canada, 3 UK, 2 France, 3 Australia, 6 China); all 17 US are own stores; 2 sit in outlet centers (Sawgrass Mills, Woodbury Common); the locator does not call them outlets, but they are counted as outlets by location (ruled 10 Oct: a store in an outlet center is an outlet); no outlets, concessions or coming-soon shown; brand writes ANINE BING, key Anine Bing

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 80 from 262 in-stock women's clothing styles (SKU stem, e.g. A-08-12717, colour collapsed); /products.json 518 products incl. bags, shoes,

tech_evidence.share: 0% (Anine Bing Sport line: nylon/elastane leggings and bodysuits with no named fabric)

craft_evidence.madein: 100% — 80 of 80 sampled PDPs state a country (Türkiye 38, China 34, Bulgaria 3, Portugal 2, Tunisia 2, Cambodia 1)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated: launched in 2012 by Anine Bing and Nicolai Bing (our-story page); place not stated there
craft_evidence.reasoning: Every sampled product page states its country of manufacture, mostly Türkiye and China. The our-story page dates the launch to 2012 but names no factory, maker or mill. A country on every page and nothing behind it is a 2.
